stances.claim: Three things need to be done to banish the pork barrel scam: (1) identify, investigate, prosecute and penalize the scammers; (2) recover as much of the scammed public funds as possible; and (3) avoid a repetition of this mess.

Beyond Janet Lim-Napoles, the conniving senators, congressmen and their cohorts should be held accountable. This job belongs to four gutsy ladies -- the 'P-Noy angels' -- Ombudsman Conchita Carpio Morales (constitutional 'protector of the people' with RA 6770 disciplinary authority), COA Chair Grace Pulido-Tan (sentinel of public funds), Justice Sec Leila de Lima (DOJ + NBI), and BIR Commissioner Kim Henares ('Al Capone style' tax investigation).
stances.confidence: asserted with self-citation to Aug 2 2012 earlier column

stances.claim: Beyond the four angels, the PCGG (per Cruz v. Sandiganbayan, Feb 26 1991, when directed by the president) is mandated to investigate other graft cases and institute measures to prevent recurrence -- and has extraordinary powers (hold in contempt, take over business enterprises provisionally, enjoin acts impairing functions, request foreign-asset freezing, conduct preliminary investigations) that the four angels do not have.

The AMLC has been given five months by the Court of Appeals to freeze and look into Napoles' bank accounts -- it should also look into and freeze the bank accounts of public officials involved in the scam. The Senate may, with two-thirds concurrence, punish its Members for 'disorderly behavior' and suspend or expel -- yes, it will take courage and gumption to expel colleagues for 'disorderly behavior' in relation to the pork barrel scam.

Too many cooks spoil the broth -- several agencies have crisscrossing and overlapping prerogatives. Fortunately, the Inter-Agency Anti-Graft Coordinating Council (IAAGCC, DOJ + COA + Office of the Ombudsman with the latter as head agency) was formed precisely to tackle 'complex fraud-related government transactions with a national impact' covering 'P50 million or higher' and involving 'high ranking public officials with the position of bureau director or higher' -- contrary to recent news reports that it would only investigate conniving NGOs. CJP suggests including PCGG + BIR + AMLC.

Perhaps the IAAGCC can string together the charges to add up to plunder, a capital offense -- penal laws provide not only jail terms but also perpetual disqualification from public office and forfeiture of unexplained wealth. Speedy and sturdy justice is the cry of our people; the prosecutors know this and will live up to the challenge.

notable_anecdotes: The 'four P-Noy angels' coinage -- Morales + Pulido-Tan + De Lima + Henares -- among CJP's most-quoted feminine-virtue-leadership coinages, here back-referenced to his Aug 2 2012 earlier column as established prior coinage.

BIR Commissioner Kim Henares as 'Al Capone style' tax-investigator -- the lifestyle-check + inventory-method approach modeled on the Capone-by-tax-evasion playbook, a rare cultural-reference shorthand in CJP.
Chair Tan revealed as 'sentinel of public funds' -- paired epithet with Morales-as-'protector of the people' establishing twin-feminine-constitutional-virtue framing for the COA-OMB pairing.

The 'too many cooks spoil the broth' aphoristic concern about agency-overlap -- CJP's gentle warning before introducing IAAGCC as the existing-coordination-mechanism, with his characteristic 'may I suggest' expansion proposal (adding PCGG + BIR + AMLC).

The plunder-aggregation strategy -- 'perhaps the IAAGCC can string together the charges to add up to plunder, a capital offense' -- a strategic prosecutorial roadmap suggestion converting cumulative anti-graft charges into a capital case.

PCGG's extraordinary-powers roster -- including contempt power that normally belongs to judiciary and Congress -- flagged as a unique tool the four angels lack, positioning PCGG as the missing piece in the four-angel framework.

The Senate-2/3-expel-for-disorderly-behavior quotation -- 'Yes, it will take courage and gumption to expel colleagues' -- a candid acknowledgment of the political-realism obstacle to senatorial accountability.
The 'speedy and sturdy justice is the cry of our people' closing -- a doubling of the standard 'speedy' adjective with 'sturdy' for a register-shift toward populist-imperative.

one_paragraph_summary: Panganiban articulates a foundational three-banishment-needs framework for the pork barrel scam: (1) identify, investigate, prosecute, and penalize the scammers; (2) recover as much of the scammed public funds as possible; and (3) avoid a repetition. Today's column addresses item 1 and a bit of 2. Beyond Janet Lim-Napoles, the conniving senators, congressmen, and cohorts must be held accountable -- a job belonging to four gutsy ladies he had dubbed 'P-Noy angels' (Aug 2 2012 earlier column): Ombudsman Conchita Carpio Morales (the constitutional 'protector of the people' with RA 6770 authority to suspend and dismiss elective and appointive officers including Cabinet members, but excluding impeachable officials + Congress + judiciary -- though she can still investigate impeachables for (a) impeachment-charge-filing in the House, (b) civil-recovery-of-ill-gotten-wealth, and (c) criminal-antigraft-indictment, and can investigate/file criminal/civil actions against legislators), COA Chair Grace Pulido-Tan (the 'sentinel of public funds' who revealed the 2007-2009 pork-audit naming lawmakers and will extend the audit to recent years to negate selectivity-impression), Justice Sec Leila de Lima (heading the prosecution arm + NBI, with responsibility for witness-safeguarding and evidence-gathering), and BIR Commissioner Kim Henares (using lifestyle-check + inventory-method 'Al Capone style' to determine criminal and tax liabilities on ill-gotten wealth). Beyond the four angels, the PCGG -- mandated (Cruz v. Sandiganbayan, Feb 26 1991) to investigate non-Marcos graft cases and institute prevention measures when directed by the President -- has extraordinary powers (hold in contempt, take over business enterprises provisionally, enjoin acts impairing functions, request foreign-asset freezing, conduct preliminary investigations) the four angels lack. The AMLC has 5-month Court-of-Appeals authorization to freeze Napoles' bank accounts; it should freeze the public-officials' accounts too. The Senate has its own investigation and may, with 2/3 concurrence, punish Members for 'disorderly behavior' and suspend/expel -- yes, it will take courage and gumption. Too many cooks spoil the broth -- but the Inter-Agency Anti-Graft Coordinating Council (IAAGCC, DOJ + COA + OOO with the latter as head agency) was formed precisely to tackle 'complex fraud-related government transactions with a national impact' covering 'P50 million or higher' and 'high ranking public officials with the position of bureau director or higher' -- contrary to recent news reports limiting it to NGOs. CJP suggests including PCGG + BIR + AMLC. Perhaps the IAAGCC can string together the charges to add up to plunder, a capital offense; penal laws provide jail terms, perpetual disqualification from public office, and forfeiture of unexplained wealth. Speedy and sturdy justice is the cry of our people; the prosecutors know this and will live up to the challenge.
